svg.title: Chame · Go Game Backend Framework Architecture
svg.desc: Chame abstracts blockchains behind one runtime: the game side faces a single API, with EVM and Solana as adapters behind it. Layers top-down: developer game business (players/items/battles/rooms/matching/leaderboards/game economy, not constrained by a default framework business model); application/ services (transaction/eventing/gameledger/idempotency/projection); capability/ chain-agnostic contracts (account/asset/event/finality/network/nft/signer/transaction); core/ framework infrastructure (runtime/module/lifecycle/clock/config/errors/health/identifiers/logging/metrics); adapters/ concrete chains (EVM via go-ethereum, Solana via solana-go) and infrastructure/ (persistence via pgx/signer/observability). Core principles: A core imports no chain SDK, chain SDKs live only in the adapter implementation layer; B the common abstraction does not erase chain-specific semantics (EVM height/hash/receipt vs Solana slot/signature/confirmation status); C modules are optional, not a forced full suite. Dashed lines are optional wiring, solid lines are call relations.
svg.text: Blockchains abstracted behind one runtime · single API to the game · EVM / Solana adapters · skeleton stage

g.text: Game business (developer-owned, outside the framework)
players · items · battles · rooms · matching · leaderboards · game economy (project-defined, not constrained by a default framework model)
application/ (application services)
transaction · eventing · gameledger · idempotency · projection
explicit async transaction states · idempotency semantics · failure recovery
capability/ (chain-agnostic contracts)
account · asset · event · finality · network · nft · signer · transaction
preserves chain-specific data/errors/confirmation states/trade semantics (principle B)
core/ (framework infrastructure, imports no chain SDK — principle A)
runtime · module · lifecycle · clock · config · errors · health · identifiers · logging · metrics
app startup · dependency wiring · module management (modules optional, not a forced full suite — principle C)
replaceable database / messaging / signer / RPC providers
infrastructure/ (infrastructure impls)
persistence (pgx / PostgreSQL)
signer · observability
adapters/ (concrete chains — chain SDKs live only here)
EVM (go-ethereum) · Solana (solana-go)
one EVM adapter serves multiple EVM networks · Solana is not disguised as EVM
cmd/chame/main.go
process entry · wires the runtime

svg.text: Dashed: optional wiring (core/adapters boundary, infrastructure landing) · Solid: call relations · Status: skeleton, interfaces land per the phased plan in todo.md

Principle A: core imports no EVM/Solana SDK, chain SDKs only in the adapter layer · Principle B: the common abstraction does not erase key differences (EVM height/hash/receipt vs Solana slot/signature/confirmation status)
Principle C: modules optional, not a forced full suite · replaceable database / messaging / signer / RPC providers · optional scaffold, no generator dependency at runtime
Non-goals: fixed MMO/room-based/board-game models, unified asset structure, forced single DB, self-built nodes/consensus, built-in custody wallet with private keys
Layout & rules: docs/design/chame-spec.md (external design draft, not repo fact — verify against code before implementing) · diagram reflects this repo's package structure
